name: Subset Teaching Dimension / VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal upper bound in terms of the other, even up to an affine-linear factor.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For every $u\ge3$, $\mathcal C^u_{1/2}=\{\{x_i\}:i\in[u+1]\}\cup\{\{x_i,x_j\}:i,j\in[u+1]\}$ has $\mathrm{STD}=u$ and $\mathrm{VC}=2$: pairs are shattered, while a triple cannot be because every concept has size at most two.
parameter_2_larger_witness: The class of monomials over $m$ Boolean variables has $\mathrm{STD}=2$ and $\mathrm{VC}\ge m$. The $m$ assignments with exactly one zero coordinate are shattered by positive conjunctions.
proof: Theorem 18(2) gives $\mathrm{STD}(\mathcal C^u_{1/2})=u$, and the displayed size-two construction gives its VC dimension. Theorem 19 gives constant STD for monomials; the stated explicit set is shattered, so their VC dimension is unbounded.
